name: debugging-network-issues
description: >- Investigates network, streaming, and protocol failures with falsification-first layered experiments. Use for ECONNRESET, HTTP/2 RST_STREAM, SSE or long-polling stalls, fixed-time drops, CDN/proxy/CGNAT timeouts, client-side proxy/TUN misrouting, CNAME-rule surprises, certificate errors, generic throughput collapse where everything returns 200 but transfers crawl, or LAN identity/topology mysteries. Trigger phrases include "socket closed unexpectedly", "stream interrupted", "fails after N seco
author: daymade
summary_zh: 一套用分层证伪实验定位网络、流传输和协议故障的方法，适合排查连接重置、超时、代理误路由、证书异常及网速骤降。
